speaker: priya
text: Hi Rosa, it's Priya. I want to explain what happened on Saturday. The festival opened about two hours late, and I know that is a big problem. I think the root cause was the stage crew. They arrived late because there was road work on the main highway. They could not start the sound check on time, so the gates stayed closed until almost noon. Around three hundred visitors got tired of waiting, so they went home. That affected our ticket sales, and that's why I am worried about the next event. The second problem is the workload. Six people cannot run a festival of this size, so everybody was under pressure all morning. We were behind with the signs, the food stands and the volunteers' schedule. In my opinion, the priority for next time is the stage, because without sound nothing else can start. I also think we need more people on the team. We were late because we were too few, and that's why I want to talk to you on Monday. Please call me when you can. Thank you, Rosa. Bye.

speaker: tom
text: Hi Rosa, this is Tom with my report on Saturday. The festival opened at ten thirty, ninety minutes late. Here are the facts. The safety inspector arrived late because his car broke down. We could not open the gates until he signed the papers, so the visitors waited outside. About eighty people waited in the line, and nobody left. I counted them myself at eleven. The other problem was the workload. We had twelve volunteers, but three of them were new, so I had to explain every job twice. That affected the food stands, and that's why the first coffee was served at eleven fifteen. The priority for next time is the paperwork, because the inspector needs a complete file before nine. I already sent him a checklist, so he will not be late again. I know the team was under pressure, but we fixed the delay quickly. The root cause was not the stage or the road. It was a missing signature, and that's why I want to change the process. I can show you the checklist on Monday. Thanks, Rosa. Talk soon.
